name: Hindsight
description: Hindsight is an agent memory server that retains, recalls and reflects on memories so AI agents learn over time. It exposes a REST and MCP API backed by PostgreSQL with pgvector, local embedding and reranking models, and a web Control Plane.

notes.text: Without an LLM provider Hindsight runs in chunk-only mode (HINDSIGHT_API_LLM_PROVIDER=none): retain/recall work, fact extraction and reflect do not. Set HINDSIGHT_API_LLM_PROVIDER, HINDSIGHT_API_LLM_API_KEY and optionally HINDSIGHT_API_LLM_MODEL / HINDSIGHT_API_LLM_BASE_URL in /opt/hindsight.env, then run systemctl restart hindsight-api.

API (8888) and Control Plane (9999) have no authentication by default. Restrict them to a trusted network, or enable HINDSIGHT_API_TENANT_EXTENSION=hindsight_api.extensions.builtin.tenant:ApiKeyTenantExtension with HINDSIGHT_API_TENANT_API_KEY (pass the same key to the UI as HINDSIGHT_CP_DATAPLANE_API_KEY) and HINDSIGHT_CP_ACCESS_KEY for the UI.

First start downloads the local embedding and reranker models (~220 MB) into /opt/hindsight_data/huggingface. Memories live in the local PostgreSQL database 'hindsight'; credentials are in ~/hindsight.creds.
amd64 only: the upstream Control Plane release bundles x64-only native image libraries.

app_vars.name: var_llm_provider
app_vars.label: LLM Provider
app_vars.help: none = chunk-only mode without an LLM. ollama/lmstudio need var_llm_base_url and no key

app_vars.name: var_llm_api_key
app_vars.label: LLM API Key
app_vars.help: Required for every provider except none, ollama and lmstudio
